lines.text: I had the glossary. I could read every column. Still Day Two — late afternoon.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Then I pulled the first real number. Total tickets, Q2.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: And it was wrong.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Sixty-three thousand, one hundred twenty-eight tickets.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I stare at it. Ops told me Q2 was around fifty thousand.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Off by thirteen thousand. That's not rounding. Something's wrong.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Here's a rule. When your number disagrees with a trusted prior —
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: The number is usually wrong. Not the prior.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I scroll. Start hunting for patterns.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Two rows. Same ticket ID. Different close dates.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Every ticket that got reopened was counted twice.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Every messy dataset has four kinds of wrong rows.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Duplicates, like mine. Impossibles — a close date before the open date. Nulls where something should be. And rows from outside your window.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Your job. Spot them. Decide. Remove, fix, or flag.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I dedupe. Fifteen percent of the file was dupes.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: New count: fifty-three thousand, four hundred twelve. Matches Ops.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Marco walks past. Good catch, he says. You almost walked in with the bad number.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Your turn.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I'll show you a few rows from an Airbnb refund slice. Spot what's wrong with each one.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Nice. You did that by hand.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: But here's the thing. You can't eyeball forty thousand rows.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: This is where Claude earns its keep. I'm sending you a messy file. Open it in Claude. Ask it to find what's wrong.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: I'll be watching. Ask Claude to scan the sheet for anomalies.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: When you see what's wrong — decide. Dupes go. Impossibles go.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Once it's clean — send the file back to me.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: Fifty-three thousand, four hundred twelve. Same number I got — in thirty seconds.
lines.speaker: avery

lines.text: That's the trade. Claude scans. You decide. On to what you do with clean data.
lines.speaker: avery
